input-field.name: testBypassEnabled
input-field.label: Enable test bypass (monitoring only)
Test-Bypass aktivieren (nur Monitoring)
input-field.helpText: Only use for monitoring/test requests. Never as a global captcha replacement.
Nur fuer Monitoring-/Test-Requests nutzen. Niemals als globalen Captcha-Ersatz einsetzen.

input-field.name: testBypassSecret
input-field.label: Test bypass secret (header value)
Test-Bypass Secret (Header-Wert)
input-field.helpText: Compared to request header x-altcha-test-bypass. Use a long random value.
Wird gegen den Request-Header x-altcha-test-bypass geprueft. Einen langen, zufaelligen Wert verwenden.

input-field.name: testBypassRoutes
input-field.label: Allowed bypass routes (CSV)
Erlaubte Bypass-Routen (CSV)
input-field.helpText: Comma-separated Shopware routes, for example frontend.form.contact.send

input-field.name: testBypassIps
input-field.label: Allowed bypass IPs (CSV, optional)
Erlaubte Bypass-IP-Adressen (CSV, optional)
input-field.helpText: Optional: comma-separated client IPs. Leave empty to disable IP check.
Optional: kommagetrennte Client-IPs. Leer lassen, um die IP-Pruefung zu deaktivieren.
